examples.title: Create an EXR output for the selected branch
examples.code:
# Add a Write after the selected node and configure an EXR sequence.
source = nuke.selectedNode()

write = nuke.createNode("Write")
write.setInput(0, source)
write["file"].setValue("D:/renders/final/comp.####.exr")
write["channels"].setValue("all")
